purpose: Teach: ニッチ/日本航空/アリーナ/ソフィア/釜山/ジャマイカ/ユニセフ/松竹

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ニッチな漫画コレクターだったな
lines.en: Riku, you were really into collecting niche manga, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful tease with a knowing smile. Leans in slightly. Light rhythm — like she's testing familiar ground. Warmth underneath the surface teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、日本航空のCA志望だったな、桜
lines.en: You were aiming for cabin crew at JAL, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirrored teasing, gentle comeback. Half-amused, half-sincere. Softer delivery than his usual cool — lets her see he was paying attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アリーナでライブ観たろ
lines.en: Riku, you went to see that live concert at the arena, right?
lines.style: Quick volley back. Bright, insistent — she wants him to remember she was listening too. Slight rise at the end, inviting his confirmation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でソフィア習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied Sofia in your social studies class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, almost deadpan. Eyes steady on her. Testing whether she really remembers or if she's just looking. Dry humour underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、修学旅行で釜山行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you go to Busan on your school trip?
lines.style: Lighter again, almost laughing at herself for keeping score. A little breathless — she's enjoying this. Genuine curiosity breaking through the teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ジャマイカ音楽好きだったな、桜
lines.en: You really liked Jamaican music, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Softer here — less combat, more confession. Slower pace. Like he's admitting he noticed something about her that mattered. Almost careful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ユニセフのボランティア参加したろ
lines.en: Riku, you did volunteer with UNICEF, didn't you?
lines.style: Voice steadies. The teasing drops. This one matters — she's naming something real. Direct, warm, no irony. She's seen his heart.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、松竹の映画好きだな、桜
lines.en: Your family really loves Shochiku films, don't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, genuine. Closer now — no distance. He's let the cool slip away entirely. Warm, almost tender. The final thing he wanted her to know he noticed.
